name: Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited
summary: Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited provides storage and terminal infrastructure for commodities across India, operating a Gas Terminal Division and a Liquid Terminal Division. It handles LPG, chemicals, oils, petrochemicals, natural gas, bitumen and vegetable oils. The Mumbai-based company dates from 2013 and has used its current name since August 2021, replacing Aegis LPG Logistics (Pipavav) Limited.
